updatePolicy: Compare each patched source and generated browser/minified entry against the recorded upstream tarball; rerun root regression and full build before updating. Restore registry packages only when all listed issues have an upstream fix.

securitySourceDiff.scope: Runtime source changes against the integrity-verified upstream tarball; generated min/maps are rebuilt by scripts/rebuild-security-vendor.cjs. Manifest/provenance and unused upstream tree omissions are documented separately.
